scope: Fixed Unicode 18.0.0 property lookup and UAX #29 revision 49 extended grapheme segmentation with scalar/UTF-8/UTF-16 coordinates. Not font selection, script itemization, bidi, line breaking, layout, rendering or Musterwork replacement.
artifactSizeScope: Incomplete development CLI/worker and Rust/C++ WASM artifacts. No complete kernel or installer estimate; fonts/graphics/media/full host distribution excluded.

candidateComparison.name: unicode-segmentation
candidateComparison.interpretation: Expected version differences, not a claim that the library violates its declared Unicode 17 contract.

limitations: The generated table covers only the documented properties, not all Unicode data. No claim of complete Unicode algorithm support is made.
Passing the complete official grapheme test file and long-context probes is strong bounded evidence, not exhaustive testing of every possible string.
Grapheme boundaries cannot by themselves authorize font switches or line breaks; shaping clusters, unsafe flags, scripts, bidi and context must still be integrated.
Default_Ignorable_Code_Point does not authorize deleting author text or ignoring unsupported variation/emoji sequences.
The runtime uses well-formed Rust Unicode scalar text; malformed JSON surrogate escapes are rejected. This is not a permissive ill-formed UTF-16 editor model.
Synchronous WASM still requires an external Worker for hard cancellation. Production host isolation, full resource budgets and caches remain incomplete.
No end-to-end typography benchmark, Office/WPS validation, rendering/playback, advanced objects, Agent distribution or Musterwork replacement gate is closed.
